title: Vintage Wooden Menu Cover · Bespoke specification
description: Vintage is a wooden menu cover with a ring mechanism for a flexible number of sheets. Ring count and diameter follow the content, and the mechanism can be colour finished. Oak, birch or pine provide the material options and may be stained or lacquered. A4, A5 and custom sizes, together with branding, individualise the model.
